title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Duty of Candour - Client Identification
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A client wants to file a claim under an assumed name (an alias) to avoid media scrutiny, even though they have no legal right to use that name. The paralegal agrees to draft the pleadings using the fake name. This is a violation of:
options: The duty to the administration of justice and candour to the tribunal.
The duty to maintain client property.
questions.explain: Assisting a client in concealing their true identity from the tribunal without a lawful order (such as a sealing order or publication ban) is knowingly deceiving the tribunal, violating the paralegal's duty of candour under Rule 2.01.
